# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

# Texture that transforms every bite

See how our collaborative approach turns concepts into next-level sensory experiences

[Explore texture innovations][1]

Mobile Image

## Formulate with our versatile ingredient solutions that help you exceed consumer expectations for
## amazing taste and better nutrition

Ingredion is your ideal partner in developing the future of food, empowering you to create consumer
preferred products that offer exceptional eating experiences with the on-trend benefits they desire.

### Unlock consumer-preferred sweet taste without artificial sweeteners

New PureCircle Clean Taste Solubility Solution (CTSS) is a patented technology offering improved
taste performance, cleaner labels and is 100 times more soluble than Reb M.

[Learn more][2]

[Picture 1118121461]

We can also help you accelerate your sustainability initiatives with our tailored ESG solutions
specific to food and beverage manufacturers. Ingredion's sustainable innovation and regenerative
agriculture practices deliver unmatched, [industry-leading sustainability results][3] that help
propel our customers in meeting their environmental, social and governance commitments.

### Measurably advance your ESG outcomes

**How Ingredion can help:**
* Collaborate to identify and prioritize your sustainability initiatives because what matters to
  you, matters to us
* Help execute on your ESG goals, measure progress and report meaningful advancements to your
  stakeholders
* Sustainably deliver products with the taste, texture and benefits consumers prefer

[Learn more][4]

[Picture 735315543]

## Our expertise

Ingredion is much more than a supplier. A partnership with us will enable you to increase speed to
market with high-quality, value-added products that consumers want.

[none, Picture]

### Nutrition, health and wellness

Our portfolio of science-backed solutions for enhancing nutrition, delivering health benefits and
enabling wellness lifestyle choices is designed to help brands and manufacturers deliver winning
consumer products.

[Learn more][5]

[Glasses of Bubble Tea]

### Sugar reduction

With our unmatched technical expertise, we enable customers to make the most of our robust portfolio
and deliver best-in-class reduced-sugar formulations that win in the market.

[Learn more][6]

[Clean and simple condiments with garnishes]

### Clean and simple ingredients

We combine pioneering solutions and proprietary market insights with formulation
expertise—delivering the cleaner ingredients and simpler labels that consumers understand and
prefer.

[Learn more][7]

[Sliced, stacked, chocolate covered protein bars]

### Plant-based proteins

We bring our extensive portfolio of sustainable plant-protein solutions and formulation expertise to
help customers bring products with consumer-preferred taste, texture and nutrition to market.

[Learn more][8]

[Overhead shot of various pastries]

### Flavorings with Modifying Properties

Ingredion’s consultative taste solution helps food and beverage manufacturers enhance and balance
flavors while solving better-for-you product challenges.

[Learn more][9]

[Texturants]

### Texturants and texture solutions

We combine our 100+ years of texturant know-how with our passion for food science and broadest
portfolio of texturizing solutions to help manufacturers achieve their formulation needs.

[Learn more][10]

[Supermarket aisle view from behind a red-handled shopping cart, surrounded by shelves stocked with
colorful grocery products. Clean, shiny floor and bright lighting, with a shopper visible in the
distance]

### Less mystery, more meaning: Clean labels win consumer preference

Discover how grocery shopping decisions are evolving. Ingredion’s latest research highlights key
trends in health, clean label claims and generational preferences shaping the future of food and
beverage

[View insights][11]

### Strengthen your nutrition, health and wellness strategy

It all starts with the right ingredients. Download our selection guide to see how we can help you
create food and beverages with the right combination of features and benefits to delight today's
consumers.

[Download guide][12]

[Picture 698766832, Picture]

### Technical documents and samples

Explore our comprehensive portfolio of products, order samples and download technical documentation
directly.

[Explore ingredients][13]

## Balance nutrition with taste and texture consumers crave

Just imagine what you could do with a global portfolio of nutrition, health and wellness
capabilities at your fingertips. Here is just a taste of the possibilities across categories we
serve.

[Bakery]

#### Bakery

# ALIDI is an international distributor and logistics operator with over 30 years of expertise

## About us

ALIDI Group is one of the leading FMCG distributors in Russia and an official supplier of well-known
international brands.
We provide end-to-end services in logistics processing, distribution, and consumer goods promotion.

We work with leading Russian and international brands as well as major retailers.

# Bakery Ingredients
# Since 1904

Manufacturing, distributing and technically supporting high quality bakery ingredients to the global
bakery market since 1904.

[ Discover global solutions ][65]

# Industrial Solutions

As an industrial manufacturer, are you faced with challenges in keeping customers satisfied,
achieving consistent quality and at the same time, meeting evolving consumer expectations?

[ Discover how we can help ][66]

# Food manufacturing for tomorrow

At Bakels, we are committed to sustainable practises and believe we must play our role to steward
and protect our planet, community and people for this and future generations.

[ Making a difference ][67]

# Insights to help
# grow your business

Our mission is to provide you with the latest market trends, inspiration and business advice, so you
can develop and grow your business to meet the expectations of today's consumer.

[ Learn more ][68]

# Global knowledge brought to life in local Baking Centres

A network of Baking Centres across the world help our customers create the best baked goods for
local markets.

[ Discover ][69]

all of the following product categories. We collectively support a range of more than 2000 products
worldwide, that meet all of our customers’ needs.

# Bakery Equipment Manufacturer

Focus on the Croissant Making Machines and Croissant Production Lines

[Read More][19]

### Find Commercial Bakery Machinery For Pastry And Bakery!

Shenchen Machinery, as a Chinese bakery equipment manufacturer, offers dough sheeter, croissant
curling machine, side injector for croissants, cutting table for pastry dough and croissant
production line for baking factories and bakeries. Our company offers customers with bread making
equipment with different levels of automation and different extended functions according to their
specific production conditions. The high quality of our baking machines comes from the experienced
technicians and 20 years of R&D. Many patented technologies make the baking machines have excellent
performance that meets customers’ needs. All kinds of baking equipment are manufactured in our own
factory, with all important parts manufactured by CNC machining centers.

Equipment
[
[Automatic Dough Sheeter] [Automatic Dough Sheeter]

### Automatic Dough Sheeter

The automatic dough sheeter can finish flour dusting, dough sheeting and winding automatically, and
offer settable sheeting thickness of 0.8-60mm with a touch screen. There are 50 kinds of sheeting
styles available.

Read More ][20]
[
[Cutting Table for Pastry Dough] [Cutting Table for Pastry Dough]

### Cutting Table for Pastry Dough

The cutting table can process croissants and various shapes of breads. The cutter moving up and down
can cut dough sheet with width of 2-20mm into specific sizes and shapes (such as triangle, square,
strip, round and other complex patterns).

Read More ][21]
[
[Croissant Curling Machine] [Croissant Curling Machine]

### Croissant Curling Machine

The equipment can complete curling of 2-6mm thickness dough sheets with manual feeding and have an
hourly production up to 1500 croissants. The curling unit and pneumatic parts frequency can be
converted automatically.

Read More ][22]
[
[Side Injector for Pastry Filling and Injection] [Side Injector for Pastry Filling and Injection]

### Side Injector for Pastry Filling and Injection

The side injector is a special equipment for side filling (jams, creams and highly viscous creams)
of cooled baked breads.

Read More ][23]
Croissant Lines

From the traditional straight and rolled croissant, to the filled and even fully bend and pinched
croissant: the croissant product group is expanding continuously. Shenchen has over three decades of
experience in producing production lines for croissants.

[[Croissant Production Line (6000-10000 pcs/h) ]

### Croissant Production Line (6000-10000 pcs/h)

The croissant machine for both filled and plain, the evolution which satisfies the fantasy of each
baker through a wide range of fillings as cream, jam, almond or nut paste, solid fillings as
chocolate bars, wurstel, cheese, ham or salame in slice, and even particular solutions for double
filling.

][24]
[[Croissant Production Line (4000-6000 pcs/h) ]

### Croissant Production Line (4000-6000 pcs/h)

Automatic dough sheeter, dough sheet averaging machine, reciprocating cutting machine, laying out
machine, directing machine and 2 curling machines.

][25]

# Bakery Equipment Manufacturer

Focus on the Croissant Making Machines and Croissant Production Lines

[Read More][19]

### Find Commercial Bakery Machinery For Pastry And Bakery!

Shenchen Machinery, as a Chinese bakery equipment manufacturer, offers dough sheeter, croissant
curling machine, side injector for croissants, cutting table for pastry dough and croissant
production line for baking factories and bakeries. Our company offers customers with bread making
equipment with different levels of automation and different extended functions according to their
specific production conditions. The high quality of our baking machines comes from the experienced
technicians and 20 years of R&D. Many patented technologies make the baking machines have excellent
performance that meets customers’ needs. All kinds of baking equipment are manufactured in our own
factory, with all important parts manufactured by CNC machining centers.

Equipment
[
[Automatic Dough Sheeter] [Automatic Dough Sheeter]

### Automatic Dough Sheeter

The automatic dough sheeter can finish flour dusting, dough sheeting and winding automatically, and
offer settable sheeting thickness of 0.8-60mm with a touch screen. There are 50 kinds of sheeting
styles available.

Read More ][20]
[
[Cutting Table for Pastry Dough] [Cutting Table for Pastry Dough]

### Cutting Table for Pastry Dough

The cutting table can process croissants and various shapes of breads. The cutter moving up and down
can cut dough sheet with width of 2-20mm into specific sizes and shapes (such as triangle, square,
strip, round and other complex patterns).

Read More ][21]
[
[Croissant Curling Machine] [Croissant Curling Machine]

### Croissant Curling Machine

The equipment can complete curling of 2-6mm thickness dough sheets with manual feeding and have an
hourly production up to 1500 croissants. The curling unit and pneumatic parts frequency can be
converted automatically.

Read More ][22]
[
[Side Injector for Pastry Filling and Injection] [Side Injector for Pastry Filling and Injection]

### Side Injector for Pastry Filling and Injection

The side injector is a special equipment for side filling (jams, creams and highly viscous creams)
of cooled baked breads.

Read More ][23]
Croissant Lines

From the traditional straight and rolled croissant, to the filled and even fully bend and pinched
croissant: the croissant product group is expanding continuously. Shenchen has over three decades of
experience in producing production lines for croissants.

[[Croissant Production Line (6000-10000 pcs/h) ]

### Croissant Production Line (6000-10000 pcs/h)

The croissant machine for both filled and plain, the evolution which satisfies the fantasy of each
baker through a wide range of fillings as cream, jam, almond or nut paste, solid fillings as
chocolate bars, wurstel, cheese, ham or salame in slice, and even particular solutions for double
filling.

][24]
[[Croissant Production Line (4000-6000 pcs/h) ]

### Croissant Production Line (4000-6000 pcs/h)

Automatic dough sheeter, dough sheet averaging machine, reciprocating cutting machine, laying out
machine, directing machine and 2 curling machines.

Who We Serve?

### R&D Decision Makers

We provide R&D decision makers with access to accurate, connected data so they can quickly
understand important technology trends, identify the competitive threats, uncover partnership
opportunities, and decide the direction of innovation.

### New Product Innovation Leader

We help Innovation teams discover the emerging technology areas, evaluate technological maturity,
validate new ideas, and find the gaps in the market!

### Technology Research Analysts

We accelerate the research process for Technology Research Analysts through automated analysis of
millions of global data points, including patent and non-patent literature. Discovery provides users
with a 360-degree view of the competitive and technology landscape in an instant!

### Business Development Professionals

We help Business Development teams identify startups and new entrants with disruptive technologies,
and track the activities of industry leaders, academic research institutions, and domain experts.
Equipped with these insights, BD teams can make informed decisions about which companies to
collaborate with.
Why Discovery?
[Technology Intelligence Data Foundation]

### Technology Intelligence Data Foundation

Discovery brings company, patent, literature, investment, M&A, news, and research funding together
in one platform. Powered by AI and machine learning, the platform is continually updated with the
latest global data points.These connected insights provide a meaningful foundation for you to
analyze and make sense of market trends, disruptive technology, the competitive landscape, and more.
[Technology Classification and Company Innovation Indicators]

### Technology Classification and Company Innovation Indicators

With our technology classification and ranking system, we help you quickly understand a company's
R&D strategy through patent portfolio and technology roadmap visualizations. This data empowers you
to measure a company’s innovation capability, technical influence, innovation originality, scale,
and stability.
[AI-powered Competitive Intelligence Radar]

### AI-powered Competitive Intelligence Radar

With our 24/7, AI-powered data processing pipeline, we automate the competitor monitoring process so
you don’t miss important insights that could impact your innovation strategy.

## Personal


**Alfred Josef Andermatt** hails from the lofty splendor of Switzerland, the melting pot of culinary
flair. Born on January 1960, Alfred has his zeal on making gastronomic creations. He has the
culinary aptitude, a fondness that has grown into adoration. His dexterity has transpired from the
experience that he gained on the road from his hometown to other parts of Europe, Africa and the
Middle East. Armed with his courage, talent, and leadership skills, he has conquered the culinary
ground and has established his own consulting firm, the indication of his commitment and service.


**EDUCATION**
  » 1974 - 1978
Bakery And Pastry Apprenticeship
Practical in Pastry And Bakery In Muri
Theoretical in Bakery & Pastry School Wohlen
Baker & Patissier Certificate

  » 1978 - 1999
Ten Different Training Course
Richmond School Lucerne
Two Courses At Fabilo Sugar Artistic School Switzerland

  » 1995
Chef Of The Year Of All
Cruise Ships Worldwide

#### Our Commitment To Natural, Local And Sustainable Ingredients Is Expressed In Every Jar!

About Us

# Quality, Innovation, And Sustainability

As a 100% Emirati-owned manufacturing establishment based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, we are
proud to be at the heart of the progress and vision of our country to supersede expectations and to
strive towards innovative developments in every industry and sector.

At Manara Food Processing L.L.C., we have manufactured a range of preserves that are overfilled with
the finest ingredients sourced from the best sources both local and across the globe. Inspired by
recipes set by global standards combined with the demands of the market, Manara wishes to broaden
and maximize the scope currently offered in the foodservice and bakery industry. With an unrivaled
local presence in manufacturing, we believe our local presence can enhance both the quality as well
as the efficiency of our local partners and clients.

It is our constant goal and aims to adapt to the customer’s needs however much we can and to
constantly evolve our range of products and services. Thus, so far, we have given our undivided
effort and attention in producing varieties and packages of fruit jams, bake-stable jams,
diabetic-friendly jams, marmalades, bake-stable fruit fillings, syrups, purees, glazes, etc.

We aim to be the “first-choice” company in providing breakfast and bakery ingredients in the MENA
region and expand our horizon globally by achieving 100% consistency in quality & efficiency in the
production of all our products & services.

# Our Aim

Manara is now one of the leading fruit processing companies in the Middle East, having built up a
very strong client base with international hotel chains and great brands alike based on the quality
of products.

At Manara, our biggest pride and driving force is our partners. We never stop looking for mutually

implemented to maximize sales opportunities and deliver the right support for your sales team.

## FAQs

Find answers to frequently asked questions about our restaurant management system.

What Point of Sales do you work with?

SMS LOC, IT Retail, Computer Dimensions, POS with Logic, Square, Shopify and more! If you're curious
whether we can work with your specific POS, contact us!

How does pricing work?

Pricing is tiered, and depends on the volume of invoices your store receives every month. The more
invoices your store receives, the higher the discount per page processed. Book a time with us to
find out what plan makes sense for your store!

Is there a set up or cancellation fee?

Nope! For now, our base package is all inclusive - everything from walking through how to upload to
your Point of Sale, to scanning invoices - and doesn't require any kind of set up fee.

Cancellation is free at any time.

Do you connect to Quickbooks?

Yes, we offer connection to quickbooks as a paid ($20 a month) add-on feature.

What kind of support is available?

We offer comprehensive customer support to assist you with any questions or issues you may have! We
usually respond within just a few minutes.
